title: Fixed-Size Ring Buffer (int)
shortDescription: Implement a fixed-capacity FIFO ring buffer used in firmware pipelines.

objectives: Implement a fixed-capacity FIFO ring buffer used in firmware pipelines

hints.nudge: When the indices coincide, what distinguishes an empty ring from a full one?
hints.approach: Choose consistent meanings for read index, write index, and count. Trace wraparound and rejected operations while checking that unsuccessful calls leave the ring state unchanged.

templates.notes: Track head/tail/count carefully; avoid off-by-one bugs.
